title: DTLS: Implement a barebones handshake retransmission detection
description:
Implement a brief next_receive_seq counter as outlined in

https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc6347/#section-4.2.2
https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9147.html#section-5.2-6

This doesn't handle (non-fragmented) out of order DTLS handshake
packets, but should be ok for simple retransmissions like the sample.

Fix #21558.
